articles.title: Fake News: CENTCOM Fires Back at Mainstream Media Claims of Abject Misery Aboard USS Abraham Lincoln
articles.summary: CENTCOM has strongly refuted mainstream media claims of 'abject misery' onboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. The US Central Command dismissed these reports as 'fake news,' directly countering allegations about poor crew conditions on the prominent aircraft carrier. This incident underscores a significant dispute between a key US military command and media outlets regarding operational welfare.

articles.title: Turkey lays out ‘mechanisms’ of defence pact with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have signed a military pact to significantly deepen defence cooperation.
